meta.title: Dir Biyabir (When Spiderwebs Unite)
meta.audience: Educated Ethiopian and diaspora viewers on mobile (9:16) and desktop (16:9)
meta.intent: To remind educated viewers that patient, ordinary daily threads—craft, hospitality, and community solidarity—hold the strength to overcome overwhelming challenges.

style.style_block: 35mm cinematic documentary realism, warm amber golden-hour light, subtle natural film grain, Ethiopian highland atmosphere, rich earth tones, handwoven white cotton textures, shallow depth of field, respectful authentic cultural detail
style.character_description: Ato Bekele is a dignified fictional 68-year-old Ethiopian highland weaver with warm weathered hands, silver-flecked short beard, wearing a traditional cream cotton shemma shawl over a plain tunic. Selam is a fictional 11-year-old Ethiopian girl with neat braided hair and a handwoven cotton dress with subtle tibeb border
style.negative_prompt: modern skyscrapers, neon lights, plastic clutter, distorted fingers, extra hands, text overlay, watermark, cartoon, anime, oversaturated CGI

shots.reason: Establish the misty Ethiopian highlands at dawn to ground the story in place, stillness, and heritage.

keyframe.prompt: Empty misty green Ethiopian highland mountains at dawn, no people in foreground, golden sunbeams breaking over terraced valleys and distant thatched tukuls, morning woodsmoke rising gently
keyframe.negative_prompt: modern skyscrapers, neon lights, text overlay, distorted horizon, foreground portrait

motion.prompt: Slow gentle camera drift right as morning mist glides softly across highland ridges

narration.text: በኢትዮጵያ ደጋማ ተራሮች ላይ፣ ንጋቱ ከጉም ጋር ሲገለጥ፣ አንድ ጥንታዊ ድምፅ ይነሳል።
narration.english_translation: High in the Ethiopian mountains at dawn, an ancient wisdom awakens with the mist.

music_cue.caption: Traditional Ethiopian acoustic score featuring warm plucked krar, airy washint bamboo flute, gentle masinko bowing, and soft kebero heartbeat, reflective tizita pentatonic mood, instrumental only

lines: High in the Ethiopian mountains at dawn,
an ancient wisdom awakens with the mist.

shots.reason: Introduce Ato Bekele at his wooden loom, connecting manual craft to lived wisdom before stating the proverb.

shots.reason: Visually prove the fragility of a single thread so the proverb's metaphor feels physical and earned.

narration.english_translation: Look at this single cotton thread—alone, even a gentle breeze snaps it.
